name: Hemoglobin
description: Carries oxygen in red blood cells
explanation: Low hemoglobin indicates anemia — fatigue, weakness, pale skin. Common in Indian women and vegetarians due to iron/B12 deficiency.

name: WBC Count
explanation: High WBC suggests infection or inflammation. Low WBC may indicate immune suppression.

name: RBC Count
explanation: Low RBC aligns with anemia. High RBC may indicate dehydration or polycythemia.

name: Platelets
explanation: Low platelets increase bleeding risk. High platelets may indicate infection or inflammation.

name: Creatinine
explanation: High creatinine means kidneys may not be filtering waste properly. Can indicate chronic kidney disease.

name: Urea (BUN)
explanation: High BUN can indicate kidney issues, dehydration, or high protein diet.

name: Uric Acid
explanation: High uric acid causes gout — painful crystal deposits in joints. Common with red meat/alcohol diet.

name: SGPT (ALT)
explanation: Elevated SGPT indicates liver inflammation or damage. Common causes: fatty liver, hepatitis, alcohol.

name: SGOT (AST)
explanation: Elevated SGOT can indicate liver or heart muscle damage.

name: Bilirubin
explanation: High bilirubin causes jaundice (yellowing of skin/eyes). May indicate liver disease.

name: Fasting Glucose
explanation: 100-125 = prediabetes, >126 = diabetes. Prediabetes is reversible with lifestyle changes.

name: HbA1c
explanation: 5.7-6.4% = prediabetes, >6.5% = diabetes. More reliable than single glucose readings.

name: Total Cholesterol
explanation: High cholesterol increases heart disease and stroke risk. Diet and exercise can significantly reduce it.

name: LDL Cholesterol
explanation: LDL deposits cholesterol in artery walls. High LDL = atherosclerosis risk.

name: HDL Cholesterol
explanation: HDL removes cholesterol from arteries. Low HDL = increased heart disease risk. Exercise is most effective for raising it.

name: Triglycerides
explanation: High triglycerides linked to sugary diet, refined carbs, and obesity. Major cardiovascular risk factor.

name: TSH
explanation: High TSH = hypothyroidism (slow thyroid). Symptoms: weight gain, fatigue, cold intolerance, hair loss. Very common in Indian women.

name: Vitamin D
description: Sunshine vitamin for bones and immunity
explanation: Deficiency affects 70%+ of urban Indians despite sunshine. Critical for bone health, immunity, mood, and muscle function.

name: Vitamin B12
explanation: Deficiency common in vegetarians. Causes fatigue, numbness, memory issues. Supplementation recommended if vegetarian.

name: Serum Iron
explanation: Low iron causes iron-deficiency anemia. Common in Indian women and vegetarians. Pair iron foods with Vitamin C.
